notes: Answered strictly from public biography (b. 9 Oct 1940, Liverpool Maternity Hospital, during a wartime air raid; exact clock time is commonly cited but its precision/provenance is not something I treated as reliably documented, hence to_5 not exact, and A3 unknown since no rectification history is publicly known to me). Part D omitted entirely -- this exercise forbade opening any reading, so inst.v2.D1-D8 are not answered. Key uncertain/conservative calls: A9 (grandparents' lifespans are not documented in mainstream biography -- unknown). A10/A11 -- father Alfred Lennon left before age 5 and was absent through nearly all of Lennon's childhood (documented), but his own financial fortunes during that period are not clearly sourced, so A11 is unknown rather than guessed. A12 -- classified as died_early: mother Julia was largely absent in early childhood (raised by Aunt Mimi) but became close again in adolescence before being killed in a hit-and-run in July 1958 when Lennon was 17. A13 -- two half-sisters (Julia Baird, Jacqueline Dykins) from his mother, plus two much-younger paternal half-brothers (David b.1969, Robin b.1973); no full siblings; 'close' reflects the documented warm adult relationship with Julia Baird specifically. A20 -- he relocated permanently to New York in 1971 and much later income (post-Beatles royalties, real-estate/dairy-cattle investments managed by Yoko Ono) came while resident abroad, but the bulk of his career fortune originated with the UK-based Beatles, hence 'some' rather than 'most'. A21/A22/A29 -- no gambling and no inheritance are documented; Yoko Ono's well-documented 1968-69 miscarriage of a pregnancy with Lennon is the basis for A29=yes. A23 -- Apple Corps' well-documented near-bankruptcy and financial chaos (1968-69, resolved after Allen Klein/business reorganization) is the basis for 'serious_past'. A24/A25 -- married to Cynthia Powell 1962 (divorced 1968) then to Yoko Ono March 1969 until his death; A25 gives the second/current marriage year per the instrument's apparent convention (see template). A31 -- 1970 primal scream therapy with Arthur Janov addressed documented childhood trauma and depression; 'extended' reflects that this was an ongoing, years-long theme rather than a brief episode. A35/B6 numbered lists could only include a defensible subset of his documented life; his 8 December 1980 murder outside the Dakota is included as A35#13 using the closest available code ('other') since no death/murder category exists in the event vocabulary -- flagging this rather than mis-coding it as illness or accident. A36 is structurally inapplicable since he died in 1980, long before the mid-2023 reference window; 'same' was chosen as the most neutral non-answer and is flagged here rather than treated as a real data point. C11 (inheritance) confidence is intentionally very low (1) because no inheritance narrative of either sign is documented for him at all.
